metadata.name: ww-input-recaptcha
metadata.description: A Google reCAPTCHA v2 widget used inside forms to verify that the user is human. Exposes the verification status as a variable so it can be sent with form submissions.

properties.name: theme
properties.description: Visual theme of the reCAPTCHA widget.

properties.name: key
properties.description: Google reCAPTCHA v2 site key. Required — without it the widget is not rendered on the published site.

properties.name: sendResponse
properties.description: When true, the enclosing form container includes this widget's verification value in the form submission payload.

events.name: change
events.description: Emitted when the user completes or expires the reCAPTCHA challenge.

variables.name: value
variables.description: Current verification result as { validate, code }. `validate` is true when the user has completed the challenge; `code` is the response token to verify server-side against Google's API.

specifications: Requires a Google reCAPTCHA v2 site key (`key` property). Without it, nothing is rendered on the live site.
Place inside `ww-form-container` when gating form submission on successful verification.
Enable `sendResponse` to include the verification payload in the form submission; the server must verify the token against Google's API.
Access verification state via the `value` variable — bind to `value` directly rather than copying it into a separate variable.
The domains hosting the form must be authorized in the Google reCAPTCHA admin console (including `editor.weweb.io` while editing).
